name: RotHeart
storyline:
You are Aria, a burnt-out graduate who is struggling to reignite her passion for music. Trying to get back on her feet, Aria reluctantly agrees to manage a dysfunctional indie rock band of monster musicians named RotHeart. To get RotHeart ready for “Fright up the Night”, the biggest battle of the bands event of the year, Aria must navigate the group’s internal drama and help them get their groove back. To make matters worse, a specter of Aria’s past is competing in one of the rival bands.

RotHeart explores creative passion and how friends navigate life’s difficulties together in a world full of monsters.
